name: voiceagent
description: Seagull Science Academy — AI Voice CRM

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "CRM-API,CRM-UI,AGENT,COST-UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix agent" "npm run dev --prefix cost-dashboard"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix agent && npm install --prefix cost-dashboard
scripts.db:deploy: npm exec --prefix backend -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:deploy
